entries.title: Psalms 101:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: I will sing - I will praise thee, O Lord, for thy mercy and justice, which thou hast so eminently discovered in the government of the world, and of thy people; and I will make it my care to imitate thee herein.

entries.title: Psalms 101:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: I will - I will manage all my affairs with wisdom and integrity. When - God is often said in scripture to come to men, when he fulfills a promise to them. House - In my court and family, as well as in my public administrations.

entries.title: Psalms 101:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Depart - Shall be turned out of my court. Know - Not own nor countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 101:8–102:2
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Early - Speedily; as soon as I am seated in the throne.
